title: Supported-open direct-image comparisons for tensor inputs
statement: Let f:X\to S be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], U an open of X, and T a closed subset of X contained in U. Choose derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] on X, S and U with the same localization universe w. Write R_U for exact open restriction [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. For E in D(O_X) whose cohomology stalks vanish outside T and any K in D(O_S), there are isomorphisms Rf_*E \cong R(fj)_*R_U E and Rf_*(E\otimes^L Lf^*K) \cong R(fj)_*(R_U E\otimes^L L(fj)^*K), where j:U\to X is the inclusion [def-pc-derived-direct-image, def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure].

source.place: Tag 08EV, support reduction; Tag 08DF (1); Tags 08DX and 08DW, open compatibility

proof.text: Use exact restriction and its homology comparison to prove that an object whose homology stalks vanish on an open has zero derived restriction, allowing the target localization universe to differ from the ambient one. In the proof, module sections vanish because all their germs vanish (TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext); DerivedCategory.isIso_iff applied to the zero map detects the zero derived object. The inverse implication follows from the restriction homology stalk isomorphism. These are the private supportedTensor_restriction_zero, supportedTensor_restriction_stalk_iso and supportedTensor_stalk_zero_of_restriction_zero helpers.

Closed support passes through derived direct image: restrict to the open complement of T, use open base change, and apply the first step to the inverse-image open. The direct image of its zero restriction is zero, so the stalk comparison gives the claimed support. Choose standard localizations only on these auxiliary opens; no same-universe family of open localizations is assumed.

Construct the restriction/direct-image adjunction by deriving the exact underived open restriction adjunction. The open direct image is fully faithful, since its underived functor is fully faithful and preserves K-injective complexes. Thus the restricted unit is invertible on U by the triangle identity. On X minus T both endpoints are zero by steps 1 and 2. The opens cover X. Apply DerivedCategory.isIso_iff, exact restriction/homology and sheaf-module isomorphism locality on this cover to show the global unit is invertible. Apply Rf_* to its isomorphism and then the component of derivedDirectImageComposition to obtain the first comparison.

Restrict E tensor F to X minus T using the independently localized derived tensor restriction comparison. The restriction of E is zero by step 1. Tensoring on the right preserves the empty coproduct, hence zero objects. Therefore this tensor restricts to zero, and the stalk comparison proves its cohomological support is in T. Apply step 3 with F = Lf^*K to obtain the supported comparison for the tensor input.

Use the derived tensor restriction comparison on U. For the remaining factor, compose Lf^* adjoint to Rf_* with exact U-restriction adjoint to Rj_*, and transport the right adjoint along the derived direct-image composition comparison. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies Lf^* followed by U-restriction with L(fj)^*. Apply tensorIso with the identity on restricted E and this comparison at K, then R(fj)_*. Compose with the tensor-input comparison from step 4. The two comparisons form the required conjunction.

proof_origin.note: K2: compiled support-and-restriction proof with standard localizations on auxiliary opens. The final pullback comparison is obtained by adjoint uniqueness rather than the global pullback-composition interface. No statement changes and no new holes.

lean.statement:
theorem supportedOpen_tensor_directImage_comparisons
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (U : X.Opens)
    (T : Set X) (hT : IsClosed T) (hTU : T ⊆ (U : Set X))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (hE : ∀ (n : ℤ) (x : X), x ∉ T →
      Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj E).val.presheaf x)))
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory S) :
    Nonempty ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E ≅
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage (U.ι ≫ f)).obj
        ((schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E)) ∧
    Nonempty ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (E ⊗ (derivedPullback f).obj K) ≅
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage (U.ι ≫ f)).obj
        (((schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E) ⊗
          (derivedPullback (U.ι ≫ f)).obj K))
